announcements.title: Consideration for our Neighbours
announcements.content: Please be considerate to our neighbours. Do not gather outside the Masjid, disperse quickly and quietly after prayers, especially after Fajr & Esha prayers. Jazakallahu Khairan

announcements.title: Hadiths
announcements.content:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Arrange the rows in order, stand shoulder to shoulder, close the gaps, be accommodating to your brothers, and do not leave gaps for Satan. Whoever joins up a row, he will be joined to Allah (i.e., to the Mercy of Allah); and whoever cuts off a row, he will be cut off from Allah (i.e., from His Mercy)."

[Abu Dawud].

announcements.title: Humble request
announcements.content:
Dear Brothers,

A humble request to everyone: the brothers who serve in the masjid are volunteers. They give their time and effort purely for the sake of Allah and to help keep the masjid organised, clean, and welcoming for all. We kindly ask that everyone treats them with respect and understanding.

If they ask you to wait in the queue, please do so patiently until space becomes available. They will allow you to enter as soon as it is possible. Jazakallahu Khairan

announcements.title: Humble request
announcements.content:
Dear brothers 
when entering the masjid, please avoid sitting near the doors or in areas that block the pathways, as this can make it difficult for other brothers to enter and move around comfortably.

Let us all work together to maintain respect, patience, and good manners in the house of Allah, and kindly follow the masjid’s guidelines for the benefit of everyone.

announcements.title: Humble request
announcements.content: “Let us all work together to keep the masjid clean, peaceful, and respectful. The masjid is the house of Allah, and it is our shared responsibility to maintain its dignity. Please be mindful of cleanliness, respect one another, and follow the guidance of those who volunteer to serve the masjid. By doing so, we set a positive example for our youngsters and strengthen our community.” Thank you for your support and your understanding
